Name: Adonijah
Summary: Adonijah, David's fourth son by Haggith, was born at Hebron. In 2 Samuel he appears only in the list of David's sons born there; his later attempt to seize the throne belongs to the story of Kings.
KeyStory: Adonijah, son of Haggith, was David's fourth son, born at Hebron.
LifeLesson: Birth order is not destiny; the fourth son's story would wait for another book.
